title: NVIDIA/IsaacCapture
abstract:
The unified framework for sim & real robot teleoperation

# NVIDIA Isaac Capture **Shared capture infrastructure for teleoperation and egocentric data.** [ ](https://www.python.org/downloads/) [ ](https://isaac-sim.github.io/IsaacLab/develop) [ ](https://numpy.org/) [ ](https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0) --- ## Overview **Isaac Capture** provides shared infrastructure for collecting human and robot demonstration data. It brings together two components: - **Isaac Teleop** supports robot-in-the-loop capture through teleoperation, including Teleop Session and Remote Assist. - **Ego Pipeline** supports human and egocentric data capture through Ego Capture and Ego Post Processing. Both components use a shared core of device plugins, retargeters, and data utilities for recording, replaying, and converting data. Isaac Teleop remains a component of Isaac Capture, with its existing functionality preserved. ## Key Features - Unified stack for sim & real teleoperation - Standardized device interface - Flexible retargeting framework ### Isaac Teleop - Currently supported use cases - Use XR headsets for gripper / tri-finger hand manipulation - Use XR headsets with gloves for dex-hand manipulation - Seated full body loco-manipulation (Homie) - Tracking based full body loco-manipulation with GR00T-WholeBodyControl (SONIC) - Upcoming use cases - Teleoperate using only non-XR devices (e.g. gamepad, Gello, haply, etc.) - Teleoperate cloud based robotics simulations - Remote teleoperation with camera streaming to the desktop - Remote teleoperation with immersive camera streaming to XR headsets ### Ego Pipeline - Capture egocentric data without a robot in the loop. - Reconstruct hand and camera poses from egocentric video with the [Ego Post Processing pipeline](https://nvidia.github.io/IsaacCapture/main/references/egocentric_hand_reconstruction.html). ## Quick Start ### Documentation Our [documentation page](https://nvidia.github.io/IsaacCapture) provides everything you need to get started, including detailed tutorials and step-by-s

>[!abstract] 一句话总结：NVIDIA Isaac Capture 将面向机器人遥操作的 Isaac Teleop（Teleop Session / Remote Assist）与面向人类第一视角数据采集的 Ego Pipeline（Ego Capture / Ego Post Processing）合并到同一套核心之上，共享设备插件、重定向器（retargeters）与录制/回放/转换的数据工具，形成 sim 与 real 统一的遥操作与数据采集栈。


# 一、动机

> 机器人遥操作与人类第一视角（egocentric）示教数据采集长期缺乏统一的采集、回放与转换基础设施，导致设备接口、重定向与数据格式各自为政，难以复用。


# 二、方法

> NVIDIA Isaac Capture 将面向机器人遥操作的 Isaac Teleop（Teleop Session / Remote Assist）与面向人类第一视角数据采集的 Ego Pipeline（Ego Capture / Ego Post Processing）合并到同一套核心之上，共享设备插件、重定向器（retargeters）与录制/回放/转换的数据工具，形成 sim 与 real 统一的遥操作与数据采集栈。


# 三、核心实验结果

> 这是工程框架发布而非实验论文，未给出量化指标。功能层面：Isaac Teleop 已支持 4 类用例——XR 头显控制夹爪/三指手、XR 头显+手套控制灵巧手、坐姿全身 loco-manipulation（Homie）、基于 GR00T-WholeBodyControl（SONIC）的跟踪式全身 loco-manipulation；Ego Pipeline 支持无机器人在环的第一视角数据采集与手部/相机位姿重建；后续将支持非 XR 设备（gamepad、Gello、haply 等）、云端仿真遥操作与 XR 沉浸式远程相机流。


# 四、对我的启发

> 价值在于把遥操作与第一视角示教数据的采集链路标准化，降低跨设备/跨形态数据复用的成本，可为具身智能的模仿学习与跨本体数据规模化提供基础设施；局限是目前以工程实现和接口统一为主，缺少公开的采集效率、成功率或数据质量量化对比，生态也依赖 NVIDIA Isaac/GR00T 技术栈。
